title: 2018 Outlook in Review: U.S. Plant Spending Forecast to Grow 5.9% in 2018
text: Premium Article 2018 Outlook in Review: U.S. Plant Spending Forecast to Grow 5.9% in 2018 Industry Segment: Production | Word Count: 880 Words SUGAR LAND--January 26, 2018--Researched by Industrial Info Resources (Sugar Land, Texas)--With the U.S. economy "running on all cylinders," Industrial Info expects overall plant spending for 2018 to be $328.5 billion, a 5.9% increase over spending in 2017, Industrial Info Executive Vice President Michael Bergen said at the recent 2018 Industrial Market Outlook in Houston, Texas.   Overview of expected U.S. plant spending in 2018. Additional companies: Tesla Incorporated's (NASDAQ:TSLA), Apple Incorporated's (NASDAQ:AAPL), Royal Dutch Shell plc (NYSE:RDS.A), Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM)
